we have developed a triboelectric nanogenrator with enhanced output performance based on the effect of electric double layer, which can be used for powering portable electronic devices.
the output performance of TENGs can be further improved by using the electric double layer effect.

the development of a new type of triboelectric generator with a simple structure that has high output performance and is suitable for practical applications.
the development of a TENG with enhanced output performance and practical application.
the design of a practical and effective TENG for harvesting energy from the ambient environment.

the proposed TENG is a promising candidate for the development of self-powered systems.
the proposed TENG can provide a new strategy to enhance the output performance of TENGs and thus promote their applications.
the TENG with an electric double layer is an efficient power-supplying device for portable electronics.

a practical TENG is developed, which can be easily fabricated and operated, with high power density and energy conversion efficiency.

a new TENG with enhanced output performance is demonstrated, which is expected to be useful for practical applications.
